Toy spiking neural network

This notebook simulates a small feed-forward network of leaky-integrate-and-fire (LIF) neurons: 2 Poisson inputs → 8 hidden neurons → 2 output neurons Halfway through each trial, the active input switches. The synaptic weights are structured so output neuron 0 prefers the first stimulus and output neuron 1 prefers the second.

Output firing-rate summary

Trial segment Output 0 Output 1
First stimulus 15.0 Hz 0.0 Hz
Second stimulus 0.0 Hz 0.0 Hz
The dotted vertical line in every plot marks the stimulus switch. Change any control above and Marimo will rerun the simulation and plots.
